s1.desc: a snowy clearing with snow-dusted pine trees

spans.view: with a small red rose bush in front of them and leafy bushes with pale roses in the foreground

beats.text: Pax bends down over the small rose bush in front of him while Polly stands beside him watching
Pax plucks a red rose from the bush while Polly closes her eyes, then lifts her flippers to her cheeks
Pax straightens up holding out the red rose while Polly turns away and waddles off to the right

spans.notes: camera locked f0-21: ECC on the foreground bush band (y 0.78-0.98) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 to f21 (step 1); the pan starts at f22 (-3.4 px). compare 0/21 keeps the bush and tree edges black. No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth
17-frame pan right following Polly as she walks away from Pax (bush band tx -3 px at f22, -14 at f23, -32 at f24; -160 px by f37 on the tree band); ends at f38
15 static frames after the pan (tree band x 0-0.3 and bush band 0 px vs f39 through f53): Polly stops and looks up as an orange butterfly flutters in

spans.view: with purple crocuses poking out of the snow around her

beats.text: Polly stands in the snow and looks up at an orange butterfly fluttering in from the right
Polly clasps her flippers under her beak and gazes up at the butterfly fluttering by the pine tree
Polly lowers her flippers and keeps watching the butterfly with wide, shining eyes

spans.notes: camera locked f54-81: ECC on the bottom band (y 0.80-1.0) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 to f81 (step 1); a push-in starts at f82. compare 54/81 keeps the trees, crocuses and bush black. The butterfly is treated as a prop (an animal, no identity risk). No overlay

spans.view: with purple crocuses poking out of the snow around her

beats.text: Polly stretches a flipper out toward the orange butterfly fluttering beside the pine tree
Polly raises the flipper high and the butterfly flutters at its tip while she watches it, beak open

spans.notes: steady push-in with a slight downward drift from f82 to the cut: ECC on the bottom band (y 0.80-1.0) scale 1.004 at f82 -> 1.088 at f114, ty -9 -> -151 px, cc 0.92-0.99; compare 82/116 doubles the crocus and bush edges. Polly and the trees stay sharp. Filled for U3

rack focus inside a push-in: f117-147 Pax (small, in the background holding the rose) and the trees are drawn soft-focus behind a sharp Polly reaching for the butterfly; f148-150 the focus shifts; f150-189 Polly is heavily blurred and Pax sharp (Laplacian variance on Polly 760 -> 20, on Pax 13-88 -> 1040). A lead drawn out of focus is not the normal flat look, so effect, per the reason order over camera_move. Also a steady push-in the whole shot (bottom band scale 1.007 at f123 -> 1.104 at f189, cc 0.995-1.000)

spans.view: with a red rose bush beside him

beats.text: Pax holds a red rose against his chest with both flippers, gazing ahead with teary eyes
Pax keeps clutching the rose to his chest, his brows drawn up in a sad, worried look

spans.notes: slow push-in the whole shot: ECC on the tree band (y 0.05-0.45, x 0-0.25) scale 1.007 at f193 -> 1.047 at f220, ty -4 -> -45 px, cc 0.98-1.00; compare 190/222 doubles every tree edge. The trees behind are drawn soft-focus (background only); Pax is sharp. Filled for U3

spans.view: with a leafy bush and a clump of tall magenta flowers in the foreground

beats.text: Pax edges toward Polly clutching a red rose, teary-eyed, while she holds up a flipper with an orange butterfly perched on it
Pax closes his eyes and sniffs the rose while Polly watches the butterfly on her raised flipper
Pax steps up beside Polly and tucks the rose against the side of her head as the butterfly flutters away
Pax lowers his flipper, leaving the rose tucked by Polly's head, and looks at her with worried brows
Polly lifts a flipper to touch the rose on her head and blushes, her beak open
Polly smiles with her eyes closed and blushing cheeks while Pax watches her with worried brows

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the foreground bush band (y 0.78-1.0) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 every 4th frame to f287; compare 223/287 keeps the bushes, trees and cloud black. The rose passes from Pax (f223-257) to Polly's head (f258-287), so it is a prop, not an outfit; the beats say when. No overlay
